title: ChatGPT can transcribe as you speak now with Live Dictation

content_snippet:

summary_en: OpenAI has officially launched the 'Live Dictation' feature across all ChatGPT platforms (Web, Desktop, iOS, and Android), enabling real-time text transcription as users speak. title: UK loses bid to keep Apple ‘backdoor’ order secret
title_en: UK loses bid to keep Apple ‘backdoor’ order secret
author: Tim Bradshaw
content_snippet: Privacy rights campaigners laud a ‘big win for accountability, transparency and online security’
summary_en: The UK Investigatory Powers Tribunal has ruled that the UK Home Office must acknowledge the issuance of secret technical capability notices to Apple. These notices aimed to compel Apple to bypass end-to-end encryption to facilitate government access, with the tribunal's ruling serving to address concerns over the lack of transparency in government surveillance practices.

ai_analysis.briefing_en: The UK Investigatory Powers Tribunal has ruled that the UK Home Office must acknowledge the issuance of secret technical capability notices to Apple. These notices aimed to compel Apple to bypass end-to-end encryption to facilitate government access, with the tribunal's ruling serving to address concerns over the lack of transparency in government surveillance practices.

【核心事实细节】法庭强制内政部披露此前隐蔽颁发的解密指令。

paragraphs_zh: 《侠盗猎车手VI》（Grand Theft Auto VI）于周四正式发售，在这款有望成为历史上规模最大视频游戏大作的狂潮下，全球网络主播迎来了一场流量盛宴，部分创作者甚至计划进行通宵不间断的马拉松式直播狂欢。

author: Maximilian Schreiner
content_snippet:
OpenAI's internal use of coding agents is growing fast, with theoretical token costs now exceeding researchers' base salaries. Even though teams are reluctant to work without these tools, the models still produce a lot of "AI slop"beyond routine tasks.

In a second report on internal research acceleration, OpenAI has published its own data on how deeply AI agents are embedded in the development of new models. The company says it aims to document indicators of so-called recursive self-improvement

While agents show a 79% success rate in routine monitoring, they remain significantly constrained in complex engineering and scaffolding tasks.

author: Emma Roth
content_snippet:
Canva will now allow you to turn off its generative AI features. With this change, you can disable the graphic design platform’s array of AI tools, such as its AI photo-extending Magic Expand feature, as well as turn off the ability to generate images with its Canva chatbot.

summary_en: Canva has introduced an 'off' switch for generative AI features, allowing users to disable tools like Magic Expand and its chatbot while retaining non-generative utilities like background removal. author: Theodore Schleifer and Cory Weinberg
content_snippet:
Dustin Moskovitz was one of Anthropic’s earliest investors, and that bet is expected to be worth billions as the company goes public Thursday.

The moment seems to fill him with worry.

The 42-year-old billionaire made his fortune as co-founder of Facebook and has, for years, been both intrigued and troubled by the path of artificial intelligence. He donated to OpenAI early on only to fall out with the company’s leaders as it became more of a business.

Anthropic was supposed to be different. Fo

content_snippet:
Korea surpassed $1 trillion in annual exports for the first time Thursday, reaching the milestone at 2:09:38 p.m. as global AI investment boosted demand for semiconductors. It became the fourth country to reach the mark, after the United States, Germany and China. The government projects exports will total about $1.17 trillion this year, but officials warned that AI investment slowdowns, chip-price volatility and trade barriers could threaten momentum.

paragraphs_zh: 人工智能独角兽 Anthropic PBC 在其创纪录的全球首次公开募股（IPO）中，向英国及欧洲大陆的散户投资者定向发售了总值达11亿美元的股票，创下全球资本市场历史上针对散户的最大规模科技股配售纪录。
彭博社查阅的监管备案文件显示，这家开发了 Claude 聊天机器人的前沿 AI 实验室向英国零售投资者配售了略超360万股股票，并向欧盟、挪威及瑞士的散户配售了近970万股股票。
尽管此前市场对生成式 AI 巨额算力资本开支的可持续性及二级市场震荡有所疑虑，但 Anthropic 及其联合创始人团队依然克服了重重阻力，将最终 IPO 发行价定于推介区间顶端之上，累计募资规模达1073亿美元。公司周四在纽约纳斯达克的正式挂牌使其成为全球首家登陆公开市场的顶级 AI 前沿实验室。
按照每股83美元的发行价计算，Anthropic 分别通过英国本土平台配售和欧洲大陆跨境销售筹集了约3亿美元与8.01亿美元资金。这一零售发售规模显著超过了埃隆·马斯克旗下 SpaceX 此前向英国储蓄者发售的3.64亿美元以及向欧洲大陆散户配售的逾6亿美元纪录。
在英国市场，Anthropic 充分利用了英国创新的公开发行平台监管框架（Public-Offer Platforms Regime），在无需单独编制繁复本地招股说明书的前提下直接对接个人投资者。该笔发售由 RetailBook 投资平台领衔协调，AJ Bell、哈格里夫斯-兰斯当（Hargreaves Lansdown）以及数字银行巨头 Revolut 等经纪商共同承担了散户订单报送与划转。

title: OCR models now digitize a million pages for under $130 as costs drop fivefold in 18 months

author: Jonathan Kemper
content_snippet: Pulling text out of scanned books and records has gotten a lot cheaper with freely available AI models. Daniel van Strien of Hugging Face compared eight such models that recognize text in images. He tested them on 850 pages from old natural history books, the 1771 Encyclopaedia Britannica, and typed and printed archival documents. summary_en: Research from Hugging Face indicates that the cost of large-scale document OCR has dropped fivefold over the past 18 months, driven by lightweight model architectures and improved GPU rental efficiencies. inline_images.caption: SpaceX raised $75bn in the world’s biggest IPO © Adam Gray/Bloomberg
inline_images.alt: SpaceX raised $75bn in the world’s biggest IPO © Adam Gray/Bloomberg

author: Ryan McMorrow and George Steer
content_snippet:
Retail investors vying for a piece of Anthropic’s blockbuster listing are facing off against an avalanche of institutional demand that is likely to leave many with fewer shares than they hoped.

The AI lab has earmarked up to a fifth of its record IPO for individual investors, or nearly $19bn of stock at $83 per share. But people familiar with the matter expect the allocation to be trimmed below 20 per cent, with orders for Anthropic stock running at several times the amount of shares on offer.
summary_en: Anthropic aims to allocate approximately 20% of its IPO to individual investors, yet the offering has been heavily oversubscribed by institutional demand managed by JPMorgan. Despite efforts through brokers like Robinhood and Fidelity, the significant oversubscription is expected to compress the final retail allocation below the initial 20% target.

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 人工智能初创公司Anthropic计划在IPO中为个人投资者预留约20%的份额，但承销商摩根大通（JPMorgan）所接获的机构订单数倍于总发行量，导致零售配售比例极可能被迫下调。该交易通过Robinhood、富达（Fidelity）等平台进行认购，目前认购热度已引发超额认购，挤压了零售参与空间。

Despite efforts through brokers like Robinhood and Fidelity, the significant oversubscription is expected to compress the final retail allocation below the initial 20% target.

summary_en: As Anthropic prepares for a landmark IPO, internal concerns regarding the risks of 'recursive self-improvement' have intensified, with staff forecasting the arrival of superhuman AI researchers as early as 2027. content_snippet:
This week, the Trump administration made it significantly harder for Chinese companies to access some of the world’s most advanced AI chips. For years, tech firms like Alibaba and ByteDance could rent computing power from data centers overseas, allowing them to use powerful Nvidia chips they were generally prohibited from physically importing into China. summary_en: The Trump administration has mandated special licensing for overseas data centers providing large-scale computing power to China, effectively closing the 'remote access' loophole.
